name: ion_threshold
_comment: Wave 7, where ionization starts: the player (Kit Lancer Ion Slow: IonizeMax 100, Deionize 1) holds the JamM Ion (Seeker 0x0020) trigger at the Ion Target Green beside it (an immobile green disc firing the Kit Ion Gun 10: Ionization 10 a hit, one shot every 45 frames). The missiles stop and the hull turns blue when the charge crosses the threshold. Pilot w7_ionthr. Take 2: the recording starts in the spaceport, before Leave, so the first ion hits after takeoff are on it (take 1 was already flickering blue in its first frame).
